rubrics.criterion: Homepage presents Academo's centered white content wrapper, navy two-tier header, subject navigation, popular demo area, publication logo strip, and concise educational copy.
The /demos page presents all sixteen scoped demos, including US States Map Flashcards, Capital Cities Map, and Geodesics on the Earth.
Reusable demo cards preserve the original Academo card pattern: one 260 x 170 thumbnail image, one title, image opacity hover, and orange title hover feedback.
Dedicated Engineering pages assign ROT-13 to Computing, Logic Gate Simulator to Electronics, and Amplitude Modulation to Signals.

The interactive demo pages support their core local behavior, including draggable electric charges and computed field lines, Kelvin-to-RGB conversion, API-free azimuth bearings, Monte Carlo Pi estimation, logic nodes, 3D vectors, hypocycloid animation, keyboards, oscilloscope controls, amplitude modulation, and flashcards.
